EC1: Subject who showed medically significant adverse events [OR] or intolerance [AND] with aripiprazole during screening period [OR] or as prior experiences.
EC2: Subjects with a current DSM-<U+2163>-TR  [OR] or 5 diagnosis [NOT] other than schizophrenia, including schizoaffective disorder [OR], major depressive disorder [OR], bipolar disorder [OR], delirium [OR], dementia [OR], amnesia [OR], Borderline [OR], Paranoid [OR], Histrionic [OR], Schizotypal [OR], Schizoid [OR], Antisocial [OR] or other cognitive [OR] or personality disorders.
EC3: Subjects with diseases of the central nervous system that may impact the assessment of the psychotic symptoms as per investigator's opinion.
EC4: Subjects who have been treated with clozapine [OR] or long-acting injectable antipsychotic drugs within 3 months prior to the screening.
EC5: Subjects who have been treated over maximum maintenance dose (as specified in each label) of oral antipsychotics at screening. (e.g. Aripiprazole>30mg/day  [OR], Olanzapine>20mg/day [OR], Risperidone > 6mg/day [OR] , Quetiapine > 750mg/day)
EC6: Subjects with a significant risk of violent behaviour [OR] or a significant risk of committing suicide based on history or investigator's judgment.
EC7: Subjects had a history of seizures [OR], neuroleptic malignant syndrome [OR], clinically significant tardive dyskinesia, or other medical condition that would expose them to undue risk or interfere with study assessments.
EC8: Significant history of drug abuse disorder (including alcohol, as defined in DSM-5 substance use disorder or in the opinion of the investigator) within the last 6 months prior to screening.
EC9: Subjects participating another interventional clinical trial within 30 days prior to screening.
EC10: Women who are pregnant, nursing, or who plan to become pregnant while in the trial.
EC11: Subjects having any other clinically significant finding of the physical examination or laboratory value that make investigator consider that it would be inappropriate to participate in this study.
